+extends Control
+## A glint running round a panel's edge - a bright point with a lens flare's cross and a fading trail,
+## and a dimmer twin on the far side. Over the panel, never catching the mouse. Paced by time.
+##   EdgeShine.add_to(panel)     (fills it; freed with it)
+
+## Seconds for a glint to go once round.
+@export var lap := 8.0
+## The glint's colour (the theme's gold).
+@export var tint := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.3)
+## How far in from the edge it runs (px).
+@export var inset := 1.5
+
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+static func add_to(panel: Node) -> Control:
+	var s: Control = load("res://scripts/ui/edge_shine.gd").new()
+	s.name = "EdgeShine"
+	s.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	s.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	panel.add_child(s)
+	return s
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+
+
+func _process(dt: float) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	_t += dt
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+## The point a share `f` (0..1) round the rect's edge, clockwise from the top left.
+func _at(f: float) -> Vector2:
+	var r := Rect2(Vector2(inset, inset), size - Vector2(inset, inset) * 2.0)
+	var per := 2.0 * (r.size.x + r.size.y)
+	if per <= 0.0:
+		return r.position
+	var d := fposmod(f, 1.0) * per
+	if d < r.size.x:
+		return r.position + Vector2(d, 0)
+	d -= r.size.x
+	if d < r.size.y:
+		return r.position + Vector2(r.size.x, d)
+	d -= r.size.y
+	if d < r.size.x:
+		return r.position + Vector2(r.size.x - d, r.size.y)
+	d -= r.size.x
+	return r.position + Vector2(0, r.size.y - d)
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if size.x < 8.0 or size.y < 8.0:
+		return
+	var per := 2.0 * (size.x + size.y)
+	var head := fposmod(_t / maxf(lap, 0.1), 1.0)
+	_glint(head, per, 1.0)
+	_glint(head + 0.5, per, 0.45)
+
+
+func _glint(head: float, per: float, strength: float) -> void:
+	# the trail: short pieces behind the head, thinner and fainter towards its end
+	var tail_px := 150.0
+	var steps := 18
+	var prev := _at(head)
+	for i in range(1, steps + 1):
+		var f := head - (tail_px / per) * float(i) / steps
+		var p := _at(f)
+		var k := 1.0 - float(i) / steps
+		draw_line(prev, p, Color(tint, 0.95 * k * k * strength), 1.0 + 2.5 * k, true)
+		prev = p
+	var c := _at(head)
+	# the glow: soft rings
+	for r in [16.0, 10.0, 6.0, 3.5]:
+		draw_circle(c, r, Color(tint, 0.12 * strength * (12.0 / (r + 2.0))))
+	# the flare: a long thin cross and a short diagonal one, fading out from the core
+	var arm := 26.0 * strength + 8.0
+	for dirv in [Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(0, 1)]:
+		for sgn in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var a := c
+			for j in 6:
+				var b2: Vector2 = c + dirv * sgn * arm * float(j + 1) / 6.0
+				draw_line(a, b2, Color(1, 0.97, 0.85, 0.7 * strength * (1.0 - float(j) / 6.0)), 1.0, true)
+				a = b2
+	for dirv in [Vector2(1, 1).normalized(), Vector2(1, -1).normalized()]:
+		draw_line(c - dirv * arm * 0.35, c + dirv * arm * 0.35, Color(1, 0.95, 0.8, 0.35 * strength), 1.0, true)
+	draw_circle(c, 1.8, Color(1, 1, 0.95, 0.95 * strength))

+func _closed_solid(m: ArrayMesh, what: String, want_vol: float, tol: float) -> void:
+	check(m != null, what + ": made")
+	if m == null:
+		return
+	check(Shapes.open_edges(m) == 0, what + ": closed (%d open edges)" % Shapes.open_edges(m))
+	var v := Shapes.volume(m)
+	check(v > 0.0, what + ": facing out (volume %.4f)" % v)
+	check(absf(v - want_vol) <= want_vol * tol, what + ": volume %.4f, about %.4f" % [v, want_vol])

+func test_procedural_solids() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	var ct = ed.curve_tools
+	ed.new_model(true)
+	ct.add_curve(_rect(1.0, 0.5))
+	ct.select(0)
+	var part: MeshInstance3D = ct.make_part("extrude", 0.2)
+	check(part != null and part.has_meta("curve_solid"), "the extrusion keeps its recipe")
+	if part == null:
+		await _done(ed)
+		return
+	check(absf(_vol(part) - 0.1) < 1e-3, "1 x 0.5 x 0.2 (%.4f)" % _vol(part))
+	var mat: Material = part.mesh.surface_get_material(0)
+	# the curve made wider: the solid follows
+	var before: Array = ct._state()
+	var k: PackedVector3Array = ct.curves[0]["ctrl"]
+	k[1].x = 2.0
+	k[2].x = 2.0
+	ct.curves[0]["ctrl"] = k
+	ct._changed("Widen", before)
+	check(absf(_vol(part) - 0.2) < 1e-3, "the curve widened to 2 m: the solid follows (%.4f)" % _vol(part))
+	check(part.mesh.surface_get_material(0) == mat, "its material kept")
+	check(Shapes.open_edges(part.mesh) == 0, "still closed")
+	ed.undo()
+	check(absf(_vol(part) - 0.1) < 1e-3, "undo: the curve and the solid back (%.4f)" % _vol(part))
+	ed.redo()
+	check(absf(_vol(part) - 0.2) < 1e-3, "redo: wide again")
+	# corners filleted on the curve: the solid's corners round
+	ct.select(0)
+	ct.begin_fillet_corners()
+	ct.op["value"] = 0.1
+	ct._op_update()
+	ct.confirm_op()
+	check(_vol(part) < 0.2 - 1e-4 and _vol(part) > 0.19, "corners rounded on the curve: the solid's too (%.4f)" % _vol(part))
+	# its settings: the height
+	ed.select_part(part)
+	ct.set_spec("value", 0.4)
+	check(_vol(part) > 0.38, "height 0.4: made again (%.4f)" % _vol(part))
+	check((ct._w("solid_box") as Control).visible, "the SOLID box shows for it")
+	check(is_equal_approx((ct._w("solid_value") as SpinBox).value, 0.4), "showing its height")
+	ed.undo()
+	check(_vol(part) < 0.2, "undo: height 0.2 again (%.4f)" % _vol(part))
+	ct.pick_part_curves()
+	check(ct.sel == [0], "Pick its curves picks the rectangle")
+	# a copy of the part (duplicate) follows the same curves: an instance
+	ed.duplicate_part()
+	var copy: MeshInstance3D = ed.part
+	check(copy != part and copy.has_meta("curve_solid"), "a duplicate keeps the recipe")
+	# a curve deleted: the solids stay as they were
+	var v0 := _vol(part)
+	ct.select(0)
+	ct.delete_selected()
+	check(is_equal_approx(_vol(part), v0), "its curve deleted: it stays as it is")
+	ed.undo()
+	# made a plain mesh: no longer follows
+	ed.select_part(part)
+	ct.unlink_part()
+	check(not part.has_meta("curve_solid"), "plain mesh now")
+	before = ct._state()
+	k = ct.curves[0]["ctrl"]
+	k[1].x = 3.0
+	ct.curves[0]["ctrl"] = k
+	ct._changed("Move", before)
+	check(is_equal_approx(_vol(part), v0), "the curve changed: the plain mesh didn't")
+	check(not is_equal_approx(_vol(copy), v0), "... but the linked copy did")
+	ed.undo()
+	ed.undo()
+	check(part.has_meta("curve_solid"), "undo: linked again")
+	# the recipe through JSON (as saved in the glb's extras): ids come back as floats - still found
+	var spec: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(part.get_meta("curve_solid")))
+	check(ct.solid_of(spec) != null, "the recipe works after a round trip through JSON")
+	await _done(ed)

+func test_holes() -> void:
+	var outer := _rect(1.0, 0.5)

+	var rs := CT.regions([outer, hole])

+	_closed_solid(CT.extrude_mesh([outer, hole], 0.2), "a plate with a round hole", (0.5 - PI * 0.01) * 0.2, 0.01)
+	_closed_solid(CT.extrude_mesh([hole, outer], -0.2), "the same, picked the other way, pushed down", (0.5 - PI * 0.01) * 0.2, 0.01)
+	var two := _circle(Vector3(0.2, 0, 0.25), 0.05)
+	var hole2 := _circle(Vector3(0.7, 0, 0.25), 0.08)
+	_closed_solid(CT.extrude_mesh([outer, two, hole2], 0.1), "two holes", (0.5 - PI * (0.0025 + 0.0064)) * 0.1, 0.01)
+	# an island in the hole: a solid of its own
+	var island := _circle(Vector3(0.5, 0, 0.25), 0.04)
+	_closed_solid(CT.extrude_mesh([outer, hole, island], 0.1), "a hole with an island", (0.5 - PI * 0.01 + PI * 0.0016) * 0.1, 0.01)
+	var f := CT.fill_mesh([outer, hole])
+	var area := 0.0
+	var a := f.surface_get_arrays(0)
+	var v: PackedVector3Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var ix: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+	for t in range(0, ix.size(), 3):
+		area += (v[ix[t + 1]] - v[ix[t]]).cross(v[ix[t + 2]] - v[ix[t]]).length() * 0.5
+	check(absf(area - (0.5 - PI * 0.01)) < 0.005, "fill with a hole: the ring's area (%.4f)" % area)

+static func _area(cs: Array) -> float:
+	# (outlines plus, holes minus: by winding about the first's normal)
+	var n: Vector3 = cs[0]["n"]
+	var a := 0.0
+	for c in cs:
+		a += CT._winding(CT.sample(c), n) * 0.5 * signf(1.0)
+	return a
+

+## The farthest a curve's drawn points stray from the nearest of the given circles ([centre, r]...).
+static func _off_circles(c: Dictionary, circles: Array) -> float:
+	var worst := 0.0
+	for q in CT.sample(c):
+		var d := INF
+		for ci in circles:
+			d = minf(d, absf(q.distance_to(ci[0]) - float(ci[1])))
+		worst = maxf(worst, d)
+	return worst

+func test_curve_boolean_keeps_true_arcs() -> void:
+	# (the user's case: a small circle minus a big one overlapping it - a short arc of the big one bites in)
+	var big := {"kind": "circle", "ctrl": PackedVector3Array([Vector3(-1.7, 0, -0.35), Vector3(-0.8, 0, -0.85)]), "closed": true, "n": Vector3.UP}
+	var small := {"kind": "circle", "ctrl": PackedVector3Array([Vector3(-0.45, 0, -0.45), Vector3(-0.05, 0, -0.75)]), "closed": true, "n": Vector3.UP}
+	var circles := [[Vector3(-1.7, 0, -0.35), Vector3(-1.7, 0, -0.35).distance_to(Vector3(-0.8, 0, -0.85))], [Vector3(-0.45, 0, -0.45), 0.5]]
+	for op in ["subtract", "intersect", "union"]:
+		var r: Array = CT.curve_bool([small, big], op)
+		check(r.size() == 1, "%s: one curve" % op)
+		if r.size() != 1:
+			continue
+		var off := _off_circles(r[0], circles)
+		check(off < 0.002, "%s: on the true circles (%.4f m off at worst)" % [op, off])
+		check((r[0]["ctrl"] as PackedVector3Array).size() <= 14, "%s: lean (%d points)" % [op, (r[0]["ctrl"] as PackedVector3Array).size()])
+	# a point of a path's arc moved off its circle: the run is a smooth spline instead, through its points
+	var r2: Array = CT.curve_bool([small, big], "subtract")
+	var c: Dictionary = r2[0].duplicate(true)
+	var k: PackedVector3Array = c["ctrl"]
+	var j := 0
+	while (c["sharp"] as PackedByteArray)[j] == 1:
+		j += 1
+	k[j] += Vector3(0.05, 0, 0.05)
+	c["ctrl"] = k
+	var s := CT.sample(c)
+	var near := INF
+	for i in s.size():
+		var p := Geometry3D.get_closest_point_to_segment(k[j], s[i], s[(i + 1) % s.size()])
+		near = minf(near, p.distance_to(k[j]))
+	check(near < 1e-3, "a moved point: the curve still passes through it (%.5f)" % near)

+func _tree_items(t: Tree) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var stack := [t.get_root()]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var it: TreeItem = stack.pop_back()
+		if it == null:
+			continue
+		out.append(it)
+		for c in it.get_children():
+			stack.append(c)
+	return out
+

+func _menu_pick(ct, pm: PopupMenu, text: String) -> bool:
+	# (an item by its text - in the menu or a submenu)
+	for i in pm.item_count:
+		if pm.get_item_text(i) == text:
+			ct._menu_act(pm.get_item_id(i))
+			return true
+		var sub := pm.get_item_submenu_node(i)
+		if sub:
+			for j in sub.item_count:
+				if sub.get_item_text(j) == text:
+					ct._menu_act(sub.get_item_id(j))
+					return true
+	return false

+## Types `text` into tree `t`'s open row editor (its own LineEdit) and presses Enter.
+func _type_in(t: Tree, text: String) -> bool:
+	var todo: Array = [t]
+	while not todo.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = todo.pop_back()
+		if n is LineEdit and n.is_visible_in_tree():
+			(n as LineEdit).text = text
+			(n as LineEdit).text_submitted.emit(text)
+			return true
+		todo.append_array(n.get_children(true))
+	return false

+extends TestCase
+## The mesh editor's Fillet (Ctrl+B; mesh/mesh_bevel.gd, driven by mesh/mesh_ops.gd): a box's edges
+## rounded into strips of quads - the counts of points and faces, the box still closed, its volume a
+## little less, segments 1 a chamfer, the corners where filleted edges meet, one undo step.
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+const MeshBevel := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_bevel.gd")
+const Shapes := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/shapes.gd")
+
+
+func _box_editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+## The shown edges of the box (12), or those with both ends at coordinate `axis` = `v`.
+func _edges(em, axis := -1, v := 0.0) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for e in em.edge_count():
+		if em.edge_inner[e]:
+			continue
+		if axis >= 0 and (absf(em.points[em.edges[e * 2]][axis] - v) > 1e-4 or absf(em.points[em.edges[e * 2 + 1]][axis] - v) > 1e-4):
+			continue
+		out.append(e)
+	return out
+
+
+## The edge from (x0, y0, z0) to (x1, y1, z1).
+func _edge_at(em, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> int:
+	var pa := -1
+	var pb := -1
+	for p in em.points.size():
+		if em.points[p].distance_to(a) < 1e-4:
+			pa = p
+		elif em.points[p].distance_to(b) < 1e-4:
+			pb = p
+	return em.edge(pa, pb) if pa >= 0 and pb >= 0 else -1
+
+
+func _closed(em) -> int:
+	em.update_mesh()
+	return Shapes.open_edges(em.mesh)
+
+
+func _volume(em) -> float:
+	em.update_mesh()
+	return absf(Shapes.volume(em.mesh))
+
+
+func test_one_edge() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 8, "a box: eight points")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 6, "six faces")
+	check_eq(_edges(em).size(), 12, "twelve edges")
+	var v0 := _volume(em)
+	var e := _edge_at(em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+	check(e >= 0, "the top right edge")
+	var r: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(em, PackedInt32Array([e]), 0.1, 4)
+	check(r["ok"], "filleted: %s" % r["msg"])
+	# each end: its corner gone, two points along the box's sides and three on the arc between
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 8 - 2 + 2 * 5, "sixteen points")
+	check_eq((r["new_points"] as PackedInt32Array).size(), 10, "ten of them new")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 6 + 4, "four quads across the edge (the end faces get the arcs as corners)")
+	check_eq(_closed(em), 0, "still closed")
+	var v1 := _volume(em)
+	check(v1 < v0 and v1 > v0 - 0.1 * 0.1 * 0.5, "the volume a little less (%f -> %f)" % [v0, v1])
+	# the arc: every new point 0.1 from the edge's inner line (a circle's quarter)
+	var c := Vector2(0.4, 0.4)
+	for p in r["new_points"]:
+		var q: Vector3 = em.points[p]
+		if q.x > 0.4 + 1e-4 and q.y > 0.4 + 1e-4:
+			check(absf(Vector2(q.x, q.y).distance_to(c) - 0.1) < 1e-4, "on the arc: %s" % q)
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_chamfer() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	var v0 := _volume(em)
+	var e := _edge_at(em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+	var r: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(em, PackedInt32Array([e]), 0.1, 1)
+	check(r["ok"], "chamfered")
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 10, "the edge's two ends each made two")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 7, "one flat face across")
+	check_eq(_closed(em), 0, "still closed")
+	check(absf(_volume(em) - (v0 - 0.1 * 0.1 * 0.5)) < 1e-5, "a prism 0.1 x 0.1 / 2 cut off")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_all_edges() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	var v0 := _volume(em)
+	var r: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(em, _edges(em), 0.1, 4)
+	check(r["ok"], "every edge filleted")
+	check_eq(r["edges"], 12, "twelve edges")
+	# each corner: three points in from it, three arcs of three, a fan's middle
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 8 * (3 + 9 + 1), "104 points")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 6 + 12 * 4 + 8 * 12, "six faces, 48 quads, a fan of 12 at each corner")
+	check_eq(_closed(em), 0, "still closed")
+	var v1 := _volume(em)
+	# (less taken off than a chamfer as wide would: 12 prisms 0.1 x 0.1 / 2 x 0.8 and the corners)
+	check(v1 < v0 and v1 > v0 - 0.035, "the volume a little less (%f -> %f)" % [v0, v1])
+	# the corner fan's middle: about on the ball rounding the corner (0.1 round (0.4, 0.4, 0.4))
+	var far := 0.0
+	for p in em.points.size():
+		var q: Vector3 = em.points[p]
+		far = maxf(far, q.length())
+	check(far < Vector3(0.4, 0.4, 0.4).length() + 0.1 + 1e-3, "nothing out past the rounded corners (%f)" % far)
+	# chamfered all round: still closed, each corner a triangle
+	var ed2 := await _box_editor()
+	var r2: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(ed2.em, _edges(ed2.em), 0.1, 1)
+	check(r2["ok"], "chamfered all round")
+	check_eq(ed2.em.points.size(), 24, "three points at each corner")
+	check_eq(ed2.em.poly_count(), 6 + 12 + 8, "a face an edge, a triangle a corner")
+	check_eq(_closed(ed2.em), 0, "still closed")
+	await _done(ed2)
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_corners() -> void:
+	# two edges meeting at a corner (the third not): their arcs welded into a mitre
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	var es := PackedInt32Array([_edge_at(em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)), _edge_at(em, Vector3(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))])
+	var r: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(em, es, 0.1, 3)
+	check(r["ok"], "two edges")
+	check_eq(_closed(em), 0, "closed")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 6 + 2 * 3, "two strips of three, nothing more at the shared corner")
+	# a ring of four round the top: each corner two arcs, welded
+	var ed2 := await _box_editor()
+	var r2: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(ed2.em, _edges(ed2.em, 1, 0.5), 0.1, 4)
+	check(r2["ok"], "the top's four edges")
+	check_eq(_closed(ed2.em), 0, "closed")
+	check_eq(ed2.em.poly_count(), 6 + 16, "four strips of four")
+	# three at one corner, segments 3
+	var ed3 := await _box_editor()
+	var c := Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
+	var es3 := PackedInt32Array([_edge_at(ed3.em, Vector3(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5), c), _edge_at(ed3.em, Vector3(0.5, -0.5, 0.5), c), _edge_at(ed3.em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), c)])
+	var r3: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(ed3.em, es3, 0.15, 3)
+	check(r3["ok"], "three at a corner")
+	check_eq(_closed(ed3.em), 0, "closed")
+	# nothing to fillet
+	var ed4 := await _box_editor()
+	var r4: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(ed4.em, PackedInt32Array(), 0.1, 4)
+	check(not r4["ok"], "no edges: nothing done")
+	check_eq(ed4.em.points.size(), 8, "the box as it was")
+	for x in [ed, ed2, ed3, ed4]:
+		await _done(x)
+
+
+func test_interactive_and_undo() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	var e := _edge_at(em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+	ed.set_kind(1)
+	ed.mesh_ops._select_edges(PackedInt32Array([e]), false)
+	ed.mesh_ops.begin_fillet()
+	check_eq(ed.xf.get("kind", ""), "FIL", "Ctrl+B: the fillet runs")
+	for kc in [KEY_0, KEY_PERIOD, KEY_1]:
+		var k := InputEventKey.new()
+		k.keycode = kc
+		k.pressed = true
+		check(ed.mesh_ops.key(k), "a digit typed is taken")
+	check(absf(ed.mesh_ops.fillet_width() - 0.1) < 1e-6, "typed 0.1")
+	var minus := InputEventKey.new()
+	minus.keycode = KEY_MINUS
+	minus.pressed = true
+	for i in 2:
+		ed.mesh_ops.key(minus)
+	check_eq(int(ed.xf["segments"]), 2, "two fewer segments (4 -> 2)")
+	var wheel := InputEventMouseButton.new()
+	wheel.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP
+	wheel.pressed = true
+	check(ed.mesh_ops.view_input(wheel), "the wheel is taken")
+	check_eq(int(ed.xf["segments"]), 3, "the wheel: one more")
+	ed.confirm_transform()
+	em = ed.em
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 8 - 2 + 2 * 4, "three segments: two points along the sides and two on the arc, each end")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 6 + 3, "three quads")
+	check_eq(_closed(em), 0, "closed")
+	ed.undo()
+	check_eq(ed.em.points.size(), 8, "one undo: the box again")
+	check_eq(ed.em.poly_count(), 6, "six faces")
+	check_eq(_closed(ed.em), 0, "closed")
+	# cancelled: nothing changes
+	ed.set_kind(1)
+	ed.mesh_ops._select_edges(PackedInt32Array([_edge_at(ed.em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))]), false)
+	ed.mesh_ops.begin_fillet()
+	ed._cancel_xf()
+	check_eq(ed.em.points.size(), 8, "cancelled: as it was")
+	# face mode: the selected face's border filleted
+	ed.set_kind(2)
+	ed.select_all(false)
+	for t in ed.em.tri_count():
+		var top := true
+		for k in 3:
+			top = top and absf(ed.em.points[ed.em.tris[t * 3 + k]].y - 0.5) < 1e-4
+		if top:
+			ed._set_poly(t, 1)
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	ed.mesh_ops.begin_fillet()
+	check_eq(ed.xf.get("kind", ""), "FIL", "face mode: the fillet runs")
+	ed.confirm_transform()
+	check_eq(ed.em.poly_count(), 6 + 12, "the top's four edges, three segments each (as many as the last fillet)")
+	check_eq(_closed(ed.em), 0, "closed")
+	ed.undo()
+	check_eq(ed.em.poly_count(), 6, "undone")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_cylinder_and_sphere() -> void:
+	# a cylinder's top rim (its cap an n-gon, its side smooth), every edge of a sphere and a torus: closed
+	for kind in ["cylinder", "sphere", "torus"]:
+		var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+		tree.root.add_child(ed)
+		await tree.process_frame
+		ed.add_primitive(kind)
+		ed.enter_edit(true)
+		var em = ed.em
+		var open0 := _closed(em)
+		var top := -INF
+		for p in em.points:
+			top = maxf(top, p.y)
+		var es := _edges(em, 1, top) if kind == "cylinder" else _edges(em)
+		var r: Dictionary = MeshBevel.fillet(em, es, 0.02, 3)   # (on the sphere: held narrower near the poles)
+		check(r["ok"], "%s: filleted (%s)" % [kind, r["msg"]])
+		check_eq(_closed(em), open0, "%s: as closed as it was" % kind)
+		await _done(ed)
